title: Governance lifecycle velocity map & readiness canvas
content:
Purpose: single-sheet working canvas that ties governance gates, sprint velocity assumptions, SLA/KPI thresholds, and minimal launch readiness tasks into one operational artifact. Use this during prelaunch sprints and the 14-day go/no-go window.

Context/why: product-ops needs a compact place to reason about how governance checks (security, privacy, legal, compliance), runbook readiness, and operational velocity interact. Historically we missed a cascade: slow policy signoff + underestimated infra capacity -> last-minute throttle. This canvas is a lightweight remedial artifact to make tradeoffs explicit.

How to use: copy to project folder, fill the swimlanes for the feature or release, tag owners, run the mini-sprint every 7 days in the two-week lead. Update KPIs daily during the last 72 hours.

High-level swimlanes (rows):
- Governance (policy signoffs, data handling, contract clauses)
- Security & Compliance (pen tests, audit responses, KMS, SOC/ISO artifacts)
- Operational Readiness (autoscale settings, SLA test, traffic shaping)
- Observability & Alerts (dashboards, alert thresholds, tracing hooks)
- Quality & Evals (prompt set regressions, A/B quality metrics, hallucination rate)
- Capacity & Cost (reserved capacity, burst plan, unit cost targets)
- Incident playbook (oncall rota, escalation matrix, rollback triggers)
- Launch cadence (canary %, ramp plan, user segments)

Column headers (left-to-right):
1) Objective / check (short text)
2) Minimum acceptance criterion (metric / artifact)
3) Owner (primary)
4) Blockers (what would stop us)
5) Mitigation / fallback (plan B)
6) Status (not started / in progress / blocked / done)
7) ETA (date or sprint day)

Sample filled rows (example feature: embeddings-search-1.0):
- Governance: Data processing addendum signed. Acceptance: DPA signed + privacy review note in Confluence. Owner: Claire Wong. Blockers: legal redline. Mitigation: ship in dedicated mode with data partitioning + delayed indexing. Status: in_progress. ETA: 2025-02-20.
- Security & Compliance: Pen test completed. Acceptance: high/medium findings <= 2 open, no critical. Owner: Miguel Sanchez. Blockers: outstanding dependency on infra patch. Mitigation: restrict feature to internal beta until patch. Status: blocked. ETA: 2025-02-26.
- Operational Readiness: Autoscale validated for 200 rps at p95 latency <= 220ms. Acceptance: load test result artifact (link). Owner: Jonah Reed. Blockers: GPU pool fragmentation. Mitigation: temporary traffic shaping to reduce concurrency + enable burst pool. Status: in_progress. ETA: 2025-02-24.
- Observability & Alerts: Dashboard with token-level cost and 3 alerts (latency p95 > 300ms, error rate > 1.5%, queue depth > 20). Acceptance: dashboards live + alert runbook. Owner: Meera Desai. Blockers: missing tracing tag for model-version. Mitigation: fallback alert on route-level metrics. Status: not_started. ETA: 2025-02-22.
- Quality & Evals: Prompt regression set pass rate >= 95%. Acceptance: regression report. Owner: Aisha Patel. Blockers: flakey eval harness. Mitigation: run parallel manual checks on seed prompts. Status: in_progress. ETA: 2025-02-25.
- Capacity & Cost: Per-token unit cost <= $0.0008 (target), reserved commit in place for peak week. Acceptance: cost model + finance signoff. Owner: Finance (Sylvia). Blockers: pricing commit negotiation. Mitigation: short-term budget buffer and feature throttle. Status: in_progress. ETA: 2025-02-27.
- Incident playbook: rollback window defined (first 2 hours), oncall roster for first 72h. Acceptance: rota published + Slack channel + runbook PR. Owner: SRE lead. Blockers: oncall capacity conflict. Mitigation: escalate to ops pager and cross-team support. Status: not_started. ETA: 2025-03-01.
- Launch cadence: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 72 hours with kill switch. Acceptance: rollout script and k8s job config. Owner: Release Engineer. Blockers: automated canary measurement not implemented. Mitigation: manual gating. Status: not_started. ETA: 2025-03-03.

KPI quick reference (single-line):
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms (hosted API), p50 <= 100ms
- Error budget: aggregated error rate < 0.5% daily
- Cost: average per-token <= $0.0008; peak-hour cost variance < 25% of forecast
- Quality: prompt regression pass >= 95%, NPS (internal beta) >= 70
- Availability: 99.9% for the first 30 days

Escape hatches and automated fallbacks (prioritized):
1) Route-level downgrade to smaller quantized model variant (auto-routed)
2) Traffic steering to dedicated pool in closest region
3) Feature toggle -> degrade to cached responses (prefix/KV)
4) Full rollback to prior model version

Decision heuristics (short):
- If quality regressions > 3% absolute on a focused cohort and user impact is customer-visible -> pause rollout and notify product/eng execs.
- If latency p95 > 2x SLO for more than 15 minutes -> activate contingency 1 then 2.
- If cost burn > 150% of forecast for > 6 hours -> scale down non-critical background jobs and throttle surge traffic.

Prelaunch 14-day checklist (tick boxes):
- [ ] DPA + legal signoff
- [ ] Pen test + remediation plan
- [ ] Load test (200 rps) and p95 validated
- [ ] Observability dashboards + alerts created and smoke-tested
- [ ] Regression eval set run and accepted
- [ ] Reserve capacity committed (or burst plan validated)
- [ ] Oncall rota + runbook published
- [ ] Rollback script and kill switch tested
- [ ] Canary metrics pipeline wired to dashboard
- [ ] Customer communication draft (support + CSM)

Notes on measurements and how to read them:
- All p95/p50 numbers measured at the API gateway after auth but before any client-side batching. Add prefix cache delta as separate metric.
- Use the "canary-quality-score" metric (weighted metric combining hallucination rate, user-facing errors, and prompt regression pass) to decide automated ramp. Thresholds: score >= 0.95 -> ramp; 0.9-0.95 -> hold; <0.9 -> rollback.

Open questions / follow-ups: (owner)
- Can finance confirm the short-term buffer amount (Sylvia)?
- Do we have a signed DPA template for EU regulated customers (Claire)?
- Who owns the canary quality scoring implementation (Data & Eval team)?
- Need a final sign-off matrix for exec approvals (Aisha to draft).

Quick links (to attach to project folder):
- load test results: LINK_TO_ARTIFACT
- regression report: LINK_TO_ARTIFACT
- DPA draft: LINK_TO_ARTIFACT
- oncall rota: LINK_TO_ARTIFACT

Owner notes (last updated 2025-03-01):
- This canvas is intentionally opinionated: it forces a product-ops-centric tradeoff conversation rather than deferring to engineering only. Keep it light; if any row becomes > 1 page of detail, move that work to a sub-doc and keep the canvas as the single source of status truth.
- Next step: export as PDF and attach to the go/no-go email thread 48 hours before ramp.

End of doc.
